item.text: The CSV writer joins values without quoting, so commas in company names create extra columns. Contact names stay in one column because their commas are replaced with semicolons, which conflicts with the documented requirement to preserve customer text. I’ll use standard CSV quoting for all fields and retain spreadsheet formula protection.
